text: Right away it seems to me like number four strikes me as the most different. The whiskers coming out, the one to the right is longer than any of the other ones in the boxes. The line inside aligns more to the left. As for the red one, the line on its right, the whisker coming out on the right is longer and it has that solid hairy dot.
